title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80% and Terra by 20%
friendlyTitle: OpenAI makes two GPT-5.6 models much cheaper
summary: OpenAI reduced API prices for GPT-5.6 Luna to $0.20 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens, while Terra now costs $2 and $12 respectively. It also introduced an API Fast mode for Sol that offers up to 2.5 times the speed at twice the standard price.
friendlySummary: GPT-5.6 Luna now costs 80% less, and Terra costs 20% less. OpenAI also added a faster, more expensive option for its strongest Sol model.
whyItMatters: Lower prices make high-volume classification, document processing and background agent work more economical. Teams should re-run their own evaluations rather than switch on price alone, but model routing can now reserve expensive reasoning for the steps that genuinely need it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Businesses can use cheaper models for routine work and save stronger models for difficult decisions. This may reduce the cost of running AI tools every day.
